parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Pro instances to query.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of forwarding rules per page.

parameters.name: QueryDomainPattern
parameters.description:
The matching pattern for the query. Valid values:

- **fuzzy** (default): Specifies a fuzzy search.

- **exact**: Specifies an exact match.
